title: Exact off-class global basin transfers to empirical exchange-stable optima
statement: Let X,Z be iid Uniform[-1,1], S_psi=X, S_lambda=3X^2-1+Z, and K=3. This atomless bounded law has E[S_lambda|shat=X]=3X^2-1 != 0, so it is outside class (L). The X-interval rule with cuts +/-1/3 is a regular DS17 root at beta=0 with I_q=diag(8/27,32/81), masses 1/3, projected separation 2/3, and Ds retention 8/9. Among all measurable three-cell quantizers -- including cells that depend on Z and, under the DS11 pseudo-inverse convention, cells with a singular nuisance block -- it is the unique population profiled-Ds maximizer almost surely up to labels and null sets, and it is strictly isolated in decision distance min_pi sum_b P(A_b symdiff A*_pi(b)) with an explicit modulus. For iid equal-weight samples with no sample centering, on one selection-independent probability-one event, every sequence of exact global finite profiled-Ds optima over labelings with three nonempty cells converges after relabeling to this rule in empirical decision distance, cell moments and value, at the computable finite-N rate P_N(z != q*) <= 3 Delta_N / eta + P_N(boundary band eta) with Delta_N = v_hat_3,N - Phi_hat(z*_N); and each such optimum is exact ordinary one-point exchange-stable under the in-bin (DS9) feasibility convention, with fixed margins c0=1/4, kappa=1/4, gamma=1/2 satisfied eventually. This is an existence/global-selection theorem, not a claim that raw population-cut labels or practical exchange ascent are finite stable or basin-selecting.
assumptions: d_psi=d_lambda=1 and K=3; exact scores (estimated scores are outside the claim)
X,Z iid Uniform[-1,1], S=(X,3X^2-1+Z); the law is atomless and bounded, and (M4) holds with phi(t)=min(1,sqrt(29) t/2)

iid equal-weight empirical samples; scores are NOT sample-centered, so every empirical second moment is about the origin and v_hat_3,N = P_N[X^2] - D_hat_3,N is not a between-variance about the sample mean

exact global finite optima over labelings with three nonempty cells; the regularity restriction I_lambda_lambda > 0 is almost surely vacuous, because a zero binned nuisance block at d_lambda=1 forces sum_i S_lambda_i = 0

the ordinary one-point comparison domain is the in-bin (DS9) one: a relocation is admissible iff its source cell stays nonempty, and a destination with a singular binned nuisance block is infeasible rather than evaluated by the DS11 pseudo-inverse extension (CE-DS-NONCENTERED-SINGULAR-DESTINATION-001 shows the conventions genuinely differ off the null set)
cell labels are compared up to permutation, and population cells up to null sets
the reference labeling z*_N uses the half-open convention {X < -1/3}, {-1/3 <= X < 1/3}, {X >= 1/3}
the margin (M3) is lambda_min(I_hat_N) >= kappa, not det/tr; the triple (1/4,1/4,1/2) has strict slack against the limits (1/3, 8/27, 2/3)
audited: the proof is self-contained and does not import the (L)-conditioned DS15 Lemma 3 or Proposition 5

proof_location.section: DS18. Exact off-class global basin and empirical stable transfer

role: first proved off-(L) inhabitation and exact empirical-transfer instance for the DS17 gate
warning: Audited 31 Aug 2026 (AUDITS/AUDIT-DS-NONCENTERED-GLOBAL-BASIN-TRANSFER-001.md): verified with hardened assumptions, publication_status still internal. The transfer uses exact finite GLOBAL optima; it does not prove persistence of a generic local root, stability of raw population labels, branch completeness, mix3 uniqueness, or robustness to law or score estimation, and it does not prove that exchange ascent selects the basin. The uniqueness citation to Liu-Pages-2020 was mis-scoped (its conditioning result needs STRICT log-concavity, which Uniform[-1,1] fails); Kieffer-1983 and Mease-Nair-2006 are the correct antecedents. No src/ compile surface is authorized by the audit.
